items.note: Closes the Samarāṅgaṇasūtradhāra's list of prāsāda types: 'a sixty four (number) of Prāsādas has been illustrated' (⚠ old OCR).
Verse summary: temples of gods illustrated as a 'Kāmadhenu for the architects' (⚠ old OCR).
Canonical prescription of laudable prāsādas: equilateral, similar flanks and columns, neither very lofty nor very small (⚠ old OCR).
Further prescriptions: well divided, well laid, with water outlets (⚠ old OCR).
Prescriptions for sound foundations and ornament; well-decorated prāsādas are bestowers of beneficence (⚠ old OCR).
Inauspicious prāsādas: uneven, too high or too low, flank-deficient ones are said to bring fright, danger to the king or the army (⚠ old OCR).
Faults of weak foundations and dislocated pedestal joints: short-lived prāsādas (⚠ old OCR).
Closing verses on choosing principal mansions for those cherishing fame and glory (⚠ old OCR).
